response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack and web software developer with strong TypeScript/Node.js/DLang background, but has no demonstrated experience in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator hardware, GPU/SIMD/MIMD architecture, or hardware-software co-design, which are the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role focused on chip and hardware performance optimization.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level software engineering experience across many domains
Demonstrated low-latency, high-performance systems work (DLang, async I/O, fibers) at Dunnhumby
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, and open-source contributions
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture experience evident anywhere in resume
No AI/deep-learning workload optimization or GPU architecture experience
Background is almost entirely web/mobile/backend software, not hardware performance engineering

key_factors.factor: No AI accelerator / GPU / deep-learning workload background
Strong general software engineering seniority and performance-oriented low-latency systems work
